lighting_isotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by uniform-bin mean on the delivered source; final water-mask pixels excluded and gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lighting_isotropy.visual_check: No cast-shadow field, sun, time-of-day gradient, or lit mist beam was observed. Form shading and local ambient occlusion remain visible on the high-oblique rock faces; owner review remains authoritative for the stricter flat-value appearance rule.

median_conifer_crown_final_scale.measurement: Median dark-conifer component width from 54 isolated candidate crowns, scaled by 2560/1254; source candidate widths span 9-57 px and the annotated census is diagnostics/c3-0-conifer-components.png.

buildable_vs_steep_fraction.basis: manual estimated fraction of non-water land area
buildable_vs_steep_fraction.method: Broad coherent upper and side benches versus exposed arch, waterfall-gorge, bench-wall, and southern chasm faces; remaining ground is talus, broken basalt, gullies, or conifer cover.

water_mask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha
water_mask.derivation: Source-raster colour classification constrained to broad painted-water authoring zones, followed by connected source-pixel growth, morphological closure, component filtering, and enclosed-hole filling; the boundary is traced from painted pixels, not drawn as a polyline.
water_mask.component_note: The upper tarn is pixel-disconnected from the fall at the dry rock lip in the painted source; the mask preserves that source-raster separation rather than filling across dry rock.
